home.heroBody: See which shops around you have it on the shelf right now, what they charge, and how fresh that stock count is. Reserve it and walk in, or let the shop deliver.

home.howBody: Pickup is the default because you get to see it before you pay. Delivery is there when the shop offers it, handled by the shop itself.

commission.title: No commission to start

review.rulesIntro: To keep ratings honest, NearShop accepts a review only when:

rules.review_window_closed: Reviews can be written within 14 days of the pickup or delivery.

policy.title: Cancellation and refunds

policy.link: Read the cancellation and refund policy

upi.title: Pay the shop by UPI
upi.body: Pay {payee} {price} directly with any UPI app. The money goes straight to the shop: NearShop never holds it.

upi.cashOnDelivery: Or pay cash when it arrives.

support.title: Grievances
support.intro: If something went wrong with an order, a shop, your account or your personal data, tell us here. Every grievance gets a ticket number and is acknowledged as soon as you file it, and the grievance officer resolves it within 30 days.

lookup.title: Check a grievance

aiLab.title: The machine learning behind NearShop
aiLab.intro: Five models, all trained on this deployment's own data, all with their numbers on show. Where a model learned from seeded demo data, it says so.

compare.title: Search: four methods, one query
compare.intro: Keyword search only finds exact words. Watch what meaning-based search adds.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: Normalise the query, fix spelling, add local synonyms (chappal, nali, adaptor).

match.title: Match
match.body: Sentence embeddings for meaning plus a MongoDB text index for exact words.

locate.title: Locate
locate.body: MongoDB geo index finds shops in range, then exact Haversine distance to each.

filter.title: Filter
filter.body: Stock, price range, pickup or delivery eligibility.

rank.title: Rank and group
rank.body: 75% relevance, 15% proximity, 10% availability. Same item across shops is grouped.

models.title: Model cards
models.intro: Live from the last training run.
models.retrainQueued: Retrain queued. The model cards update when it finishes.

quality.title: Search quality, measured
quality.intro: Labelled queries run through the live search on a fixed copy of the demo city. Queries counts those with a relevant item in range out of all; no results is the share of those that found nothing.
quality.syntheticNote: Synthetic example rows only: not a quality measurement until the labelled set arrives.

quality.captionTest: Search quality on the test split, by language

live.title: Live search, measured
live.intro: No results over all searches comes from the search log. The other figures count only signed-in customers who allow search measurement, and hold nothing that identifies them.
